valid.proposed-open-empty-evidence.json: A proposed Review explicitly records an empty considered-evidence set.
valid.active-open-participant-account-evidence: Active participant-specific Review cites an exact Account.
valid.active-in-review-mixed-evidence.json: Active Review cites exact Observation and typed sibling-module material.
valid.awaiting-information-requested-by.json: Review waiting for information preserves a represented requester independently of trigger.
valid.completed-without-finding-or-evidence.js: Completion does not force a finding or judgment record.
valid.reconsideration-subject-determination.js: Reconsideration Review identifies the exact prior Determination as its subject.
valid.cancelled-valid-history.json: Cancellation is valid workflow history rather than invalidation.
valid.paper-proposed.json: Ingested paper-derived Review remains proposed pending local acceptance.
valid.import-historical-proposed.json: Imported historical completed Review preserves unidentified reviewer honestly while remaining proposed.
valid.participant-set-target.json: One Review may concern an explicit Event Participant set.
valid.classification-review-subject.json: Classification review identifies an exact Classification subject.
valid.correction-successor.json: One-to-one material Review correction preserves exact predecessor history.
valid.duplicate-consolidation-successor.json: Duplicate consolidation may name multiple Review predecessors.
valid.work-root-correction-successor.json: Ownership correction preserves Review identity across Event roots.
valid.other-trigger-and-question.json: Bounded other initiation and question forms remain representable.

invalid.missing-evidence-considered.json: Review must explicitly preserve the considered-evidence set even when empty.
invalid.retracted-status.json: Review has no retracted lifecycle state.
invalid.question-missing-text.json: Every Review question has bounded text.
invalid.direct-student-target.json: Review targets reuse Event-local portia_target_ref rather than person identity.
invalid.system-process-reviewer.json: A system process cannot structurally masquerade as the represented human reviewer.
invalid.system-process-requester.json: A system process is not represented-human request attribution.
invalid.paper-preallocated.json: Paper preallocation cannot create canonical Review content.
invalid.raw-source-artifact-evidence.json: Raw artifacts bypassing Account/Observation are not judgment evidence.
invalid.embedded-evidence-content.json: Review evidence references do not embed substantive evidence payloads.
invalid.duplicate-exact-evidence.json: Exact duplicate evidence references are rejected structurally.
invalid.review-subject-account.json: Review subjects are judgment-layer records, not Account evidence.
invalid.review-subject-null-version.json: Review subjects are exact versioned representations.
invalid.supersedes-wrong-record-kind.json: Review supersession targets Review records only.
invalid.unexpected-finding-field.json: Review cannot carry a finding field.
invalid.unexpected-urgency-field.json: Routing urgency is not a canonical Review judgment field.

application_invalid.active-paper-without-review-history.json: Paper-derived Review cannot become active without accepted review history.
application_invalid.active-import-without-review-history.jso: Imported Review cannot become active without accepted review history.
application_invalid.reconsideration-without-subject.json: Reconsideration requires an exact judgment subject.
Event-local reconsideration subject belongs to another Event.
application_invalid.self-review-subject.json: A Review cannot name itself as the record under review.
application_invalid.duplicate-logical-review-subject.json: The same logical subject cannot be repeated through different work representations.
application_invalid.module-evidence-id-mismatch.json: Sibling-module work and record module IDs must agree.
application_invalid.self-supersession.json: Ordinary Review correction cannot supersede itself.
application_invalid.ordinary-correction-cross-work.json: Ordinary Review correction cannot cross Event roots.
application_invalid.work-root-correction-same-work.json: Work-root correction requires a changed Event root.
application_invalid.work-root-correction-id-changed.json: Work-root correction preserves Review logical identity.
application_invalid.mixed-supersession-reasons.json: One successor operation uses one logical reason.
application_invalid.single-predecessor-duplicate-consolidati: Duplicate consolidation requires at least two logical predecessors.
